name: pin-drop
title: Pin Drop
description: A pin on a picture (a map, a floor plan, a diagram). On a phone, `PinDrop` lets each person place one pin by tap, drag or arrow keys. With an `answer` it is "Where is it?": once the host reveals, the answer appears, a line joins it to the viewer's pin, and…
author: ofri-peretz <https://github.com/ofri-peretz>
docs:
## @interlace/pin-drop

Installed to `components/ui/games/pin-drop.tsx`.

```tsx
import { /* … */ } from '@/components/ui/games/pin-drop';
```

Props, a11y contract, live preview and source: https://ds.interlace.tools/c/pin-drop

Requires the `@interlace/interlace-base` CSS baseline (installed automatically as a registry dependency). For the Interlace look, also add `@interlace/theme`.
